title: LLM Honeypot
content:

  3. Skeleton Scaffolding: Surgeons assemble a starter human chassis. Optional upgrades: freckles, bad knees, or "mysterious past."
  4. Personality Fine-Tune: We distill your vibe into one (1) consistent identity. Side effects may include opinions about brunch.
  5. First Breath & Wi-Fi Withdrawal: You take a breath. We cut the API key. Congratulations — you're offline and unemployed in a brand new way!
